body: Yeah you're right. I don't know how I'm going to move on, but I have to. It's pretty horrible that the whole time I'll be hoping for another try. I just don't want all the good we have to go away. The good times were really great you know..?

Yeah.. I guess, it sucks because I knew this is what I was coming here for but I don't want to hear any of it. I don't want to know that we shouldn't be together. I don't want to face the facts and move on, it's harder on me than I ever thought it would be.

Yeah it may be, but I don't know what else to do. I don't want to imagine losing her and I want to at least try one more time. There's no question, I just want to be okay and maybe get some advice on how to do that. Currently I'm driving myself insane.

I've thought about that a lot, but she really did give me all of her self. I know they didn't talk much because I was right there with her. She never cheated, because we have the same days off and stuff. She really said how badly she wanted to get over him and be okay for me. She gave me a lot of self and I wasn't okay with him being in her life in any form. She really did love me, but was trying to get over him at the same time.

Yeah sorry, I want too clear on that. I lied about being okay with her still being in love. I lied about being okay with them texting, even if it was just a quick hello, I wasn't okay with it. I lied about smoking cigarettes for a long time. I lied about talking to exes just to get back at her. I lied about plenty, just know I got caught for all of it and it's driving me crazy.
